scripts.copy-assets: cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/css/bootstrap.min.css src/main/webapp/css/ && cp node_modules/bootstrap/dist/js/bootstrap.bundle.min.js src/main/webapp/js/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.css src/main/webapp/css/ && cp node_modules/leaflet/dist/leaflet.js src/main/webapp/js/
